title: Florida Woman Shreds Park in Audi SUV, Kicks Cop During Arrest!
description:
On April 22nd, 2024, deputies in Florida responded to multiple reports of a black Audi SUV doing donuts in a park. Upon arrival, the deputy observed the black SUV driving erratically, tearing up the grass. When a deputy approached the vehicle and ordered the suspect to stop, the suspect honked the horn and accelerated, attempting to flee the scene. The deputy was eventually able to stop the vehicle, but the suspect refused to exit.

The suspect refused to listen to deputies and was placed in handcuffs. After being escorted to the hospital for medical clearance the suspect later kicked a deputy in the chest. The suspect was charged with Fleeing or Attempting to Elude a Law Enforcement Officer, Battery on Law Enforcement Officer, Resisting without Violence, Felony Criminal Mischief, and Reckless Driving.
